## Common Aggregations

该表本身是 shop_id 粒度的 to-date 汇总，下游查询通常不做进一步聚合，而是直接取 `gmv_usd_td` 做比较运算：

- **Seller Tier**: `CASE WHEN gmv_usd_td_current - gmv_usd_td_prev >= threshold THEN 'large_seller' ...`
- **Seller Status**: `CASE WHEN prev_gmv = 0 THEN 'new' WHEN curr_gmv - prev_gmv = 0 THEN 'churn' ...`

## Representative SQL Snippets

### 1. Seller Tier Classification (ads_advertise_mkt_1d / dim_shop_info)

```sql
-- Compare current month-end vs previous month-end GMV to classify seller tier
create or replace temporary view seller_tier as
select
    a.shop_id,
    case when coalesce(a.gmv_usd_td,0)-coalesce(b.gmv_usd_td,0) >= larger_seller_min_value then 'large_seller'
         when coalesce(a.gmv_usd_td,0)-coalesce(b.gmv_usd_td,0) >= medium_seller_min_value
              and coalesce(a.gmv_usd_td,0)-coalesce(b.gmv_usd_td,0) < larger_seller_min_value then 'medium_seller'
         when coalesce(a.gmv_usd_td,0)-coalesce(b.gmv_usd_td,0) >= small_seller_min_value
              and coalesce(a.gmv_usd_td,0)-coalesce(b.gmv_usd_td,0) < medium_seller_min_value then 'small_seller'
         else 'micro_seller'
    end as seller_tier
from
(
    select shop_id, gmv_usd_td
    from mp_order.dws_seller_gmv_td__reg_s0_live
    where grass_region = upper('${region}')
      and grass_date = date_trunc('month', '${grass_date}') - interval '1' day
      and tz_type = 'local' and gmv_usd_td > 0
) a
full join
(
    select shop_id, gmv_usd_td
    from mp_order.dws_seller_gmv_td__reg_s0_live
    where grass_region = upper('${region}')
      and grass_date = date_trunc('month', date_trunc('month', '${grass_date}') - interval '1' day) - interval '1' day
      and tz_type = 'local' and gmv_usd_td > 0
) b
on a.shop_id = b.shop_id
left join seller_tier_threshold d on 1=1;
```

### 2. Seller Status Lifecycle (dim_shop_info_daily / dim_shop_info_monthly)

```sql
-- 3-way self-join to determine seller lifecycle status
create or replace temporary view seller_status as
select
    a.shop_id,
    case
        when coalesce(b.gmv_usd_td,0) = 0 then 'new'
        when (b.gmv_usd_td-coalesce(c.gmv_usd_td,0)) > 0
             and (a.gmv_usd_td-b.gmv_usd_td) = 0 then 'churn'
        when (b.gmv_usd_td-coalesce(c.gmv_usd_td,0)) > 0
             and (a.gmv_usd_td-b.gmv_usd_td) > 0 then 'existing'
        when c.gmv_usd_td > 0
             and (b.gmv_usd_td-coalesce(c.gmv_usd_td,0)) = 0
             and (a.gmv_usd_td-b.gmv_usd_td) > 0 then 'reactivated'
        when (b.gmv_usd_td-coalesce(c.gmv_usd_td,0)) = 0
             and (a.gmv_usd_td-b.gmv_usd_td) = 0 then 'churned_before'
        else 'others'
    end as seller_status
from
    (select shop_id, gmv_usd_td from mp_order.dws_seller_gmv_td__reg_s0_live
     where grass_region = upper('${region}')
       and grass_date = date_trunc('month', '${grass_date}') - interval '1' day
       and tz_type = 'local' and gmv_usd_td > 0) a
full join
    (select shop_id, gmv_usd_td from mp_order.dws_seller_gmv_td__reg_s0_live
     where grass_region = upper('${region}')
       and grass_date = date_trunc('month', date_trunc('month', '${grass_date}') - interval '1' day) - interval '1' day
       and tz_type = 'local' and gmv_usd_td > 0) b
on a.shop_id = b.shop_id
left join
    (select shop_id, gmv_usd_td from mp_order.dws_seller_gmv_td__reg_s0_live
     where grass_date = date_trunc('month', date_trunc('month', date_trunc('month', '${grass_date}')
       - interval '1' day) - interval '1' day) - interval '1' day
       and tz_type = 'local' and gmv_usd_td > 0
       and grass_region = upper('${region}')) c
on a.shop_id = c.shop_id
left join seller_tier_threshold d on 1=1;
```

### 3. Effective Shop Filtering (target_audience workflows)

```sql
-- Filter shops that are active (status=1) AND have GMV > 0
CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW effective_shop as
select a.shop_id from (
    select shop_id
    from mp_user.dim_shop__reg_s0_live
    where grass_region = upper('${region}')
      and grass_date = date'${yesterday}'
      and tz_type = 'local'
      and status = 1
      and user_status = 1
) a
inner join (
    select shop_id
    from mp_order.dws_seller_gmv_td__reg_s0_live
    where tz_type = 'local' and grass_region = upper('${region}')
      and grass_date = date'${yesterday}' and gmv_td > 0
) b
on a.shop_id = b.shop_id;
```
